notes:
aurora_lint 1504 (v0.5.3 step 3), valkey EXP33-C batch 2 of 3. Baseline, not a delta: valkey had no EXP33-C labels. Stacked on delta-1504-valkey-exp33c-b1; this branch adds only this batch's rows over that parent.

POPULATION. Same as batch 1: run 274 (05bd14f9) unlabeled keys, in scope, diffed against main. This batch holds the remaining 84 "Static variable 'X' used without explicit initialization" keys (all in valkey-cli.c) and the first 44 keys (by file) of the other EXP33-C shapes.

GATE CHECK. aurora_lint 1435 affects only "Passing pointer to uninitialized variable" on explicitly-initialized file-scope statics. valkey's 15 keys of that shape all pass locals, so it removes none of them.

STANDARD. Static-storage shape: zero-initialized by C11 6.7.9p10, as in all 287 existing labels. Other shapes: TP only if some path in the pinned tree reads the object before assigning it. FP when every path assigns it first, when the flagged use is not a read (address-of into a filling callee, a macro that only writes, pointer arithmetic), or when the path ends in serverPanic/serverAssert (unconditional, no NDEBUG arm, noreturn on failure). Config-gated arms count as written (ADR-0010 Decision 1).

METHOD. One read-only agent, spot-checked at source by the adjudicator (debug.c:330-360, evict.c:626-632).

RESULT: 127 FP / 1 TP.
- TP: src/debug.c:356 (mallctl_int). val is assigned only under argc > 1 and is read in the BIG_ENDIAN arm of the EINVAL retry branch (medium confidence).
- Misfire: src/evict.c:630. The 'db' at that line is the type token of the latencyTraceIfNeeded macro (valkey_##type##_trace), not the local serverDb *db, which is out of scope there.
- Medium-confidence FPs: anet.c:171/172/173 (UNUSED(x) = ((void)x) on variables assigned only on the listed platforms; the void cast discards the value) and debug.c:2573 (strncmp over a fgets_async_signal_safe buffer, which stops at the written newline).

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision/recall claim is made here.
